claims.text: Mixed amphetamine salts ER (Adderall XR): ADHD in adults and pts ≥ 6 y;
claims.quote: ADDERALL XR, a CNS stimulant, is indicated for the treatment of Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD) in adults and pediatric patients 6 years and older.

claims.text: ⍉recommended < 6 y (higher drug exposure and more AEs, eg, wt loss).
claims.quote: The use of ADDERALL XR is not recommended in pediatric patients younger than 6 years of age because they had higher plasma exposure and a higher incidence of adverse reactions (e.g., weight loss) than patients 6 years and older at the same dosage.

claims.text: Dextroamphetamine doses are about two thirds of methylphenidate doses.
claims.quote: In general, dextroamphetamine doses are approximately two thirds those of methylphenidate doses.

claims.text: CI: an MAOI now or w.in 14 days of stopping one.
claims.quote: taking monoamine oxidase inhibitors (MAOIs), or within 14 days of stopping MAOIs
